QorCap v0.3.33: audible challenge alert and scorebug re-anchor

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged. Nothing new is written to the receipt or a checkpoint.

- When QorTime posts a liveness challenge, the console plays a loud three-beep clip, shows a Windows toast with the prompt, and flashes the console caption and taskbar button until the window is focused. The alerts run on a separate worker after the challenge is recorded, so the issued and deadline times do not move. Set `QORCAP_CHALLENGE_BEEP=0` to skip the clip; the old `MessageBeep` still runs. PR #83.
- The standard-bar scorebug reader re-anchors a stuck score lock when the same new score keeps passing the existing gates. On an unresolved disagreement it publishes null scores and winner `unknown`, unless a gated end-menu final is present. Re-anchor notes are written to `reanchor_notes.jsonl` in the match bundle, not to the receipt. Clock and banner templates cut from held-out matches were removed. PR #76.
- Vendored `contracts/compat.json` is re-vendored from QorTime, and a CI job compares the vendored contracts against QorTime main. PRs #72, #74.
- CI runs the sidecar scorebug reader tests on Linux and Windows. PR #73.
